email.body1:
Rory, saw Nitro just launched Smart Redact and is rolling out the new AI Tools tab across PDF Pro.

A wave of AI launches usually means more in-market accounts in play than a North America team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nitro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rory, quick follow-up for Nitro.

New AI features expand the buyers worth chasing faster than headcount can keep up, so accounts go untouched and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the North America team needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rory, last bit of proof for Nitro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nitro reply rate likely compares to other document-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rory, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling North America coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a launch cycle is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your North America motion? I will tailor it to Nitro either way.
